title: sedum corymbulosum
intro: Sedum corymbulosum, commonly known as White Sedum, is a type of succulent plant that belongs to the Crassulaceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems and skin conditions, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Sedum corymbulosum include its ability to soothe and calm the mind and body, making it useful in treating anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of Sedum corymbulosum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
